scope: Proposition 7.3 (The normalized root family and its fixed deck datum) of the manuscript “Abelian covers, Gale correspondences, and the Hodge conjecture for powers” (preprints/Abelian-covers-Gale-correspondences-and-the-Hodge-conjecture-for-powers-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3467c8077855a568), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The map ρ : e D2,m,n := Mm × (Gm)m−1 → D2,m, (z, h2, . . . , hm) 7→ (z, hn 2 , . . . , hn m) is a connected finite étale cover of degree nm−1. Set h1 = 1. Over it, the algebraic maps [yi] 7→ [hiyi] and [xi] 7→ [h−1 i xi] identify the normalized dual and original root families with the families for Q(t, z) and P(t, z), respectively. They commute with Gm,n. Every qz is a connected Gm,n-cover of P1, with ordered branch points (∞, 0, 1, z4, . . . , zm). Identify Gm,n ≃ (Z/n)m /⟨(1, . . . , 1)⟩ using ζn = exp(2πi/n). Its ordered positive local monodromies are the images (ē1, . . . , ēm) of the standard basis. The family runs over all ordered branch configurations with this fixed deck datum.
